title: MaturityResult
description: Layer 3 output: maturity level (1-5) and recommended action. This artifact stays in the session and is never written to disk, and nothing validates it against this schema. The schema is a checklist of what the layer should have resolved, so the user-facing brief comes out complete; an unresolved field belongs in gaps, not omitted.

rationale.description: Each entry cites the discovery/capability fields and the matrix rule that produced the verdict.
